Having picked up the old key, make it so that the wooden door inside the bedroom is unlocked. If you have unlocked the wooden door, make it so that the wooden door inside the bedroom is open. After that, travel east. And then, ensure that the screen door in the kitchen is open. And then, venture east. And then, travel south. After that, pick-up the lettuce from the floor of the garden. And then, make an attempt to take a trip north. After that, head west. If you can accomplish that, rest the lettuce on the stove. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
